name: GY94
title: The Goldman & Yang (1994) model of dN/dS

args.name: kappa
args.description: Transition rate relative to transversion rate, before accounting for frequencies

args.name: omega
args.description: Rate multiplier for nonsynonymous substitutions relative to synonymous substitutions

citation.title: A codon-based model of nucleotide substitution for protein-coding DNA sequences

description:
A codon substitution model allowing different rates for transitions and transversions and for synonymous and nonsynonymous changes. Each instantaneous substitution changes one nucleotide. Rates are proportional to the destination codon frequency, multiplied by kappa for transitions and by omega for nonsynonymous changes.

Codon frequencies can be specified freely or constructed from nucleotide frequencies with F1x4 or F3x4.
